name: trace.command
description: One game-trace entry per command: decision, delta digest, RNG draws, commit outcome, committed events and effect ids (11 §15; 09 §7). Producers: loka play and the simulator (R5), the local authority (R6).

name: content.diagnostic
description: One structured diagnostic (08 §6; cartridge.schema.json Diagnostic). Producers: mix loka.compile (R4) and the TypeScript cartridge loader, through loka play (R5).

name: simulation.invariant_failed
description: A registered invariant failed after a command; the ids are the deterministic repro (09 §2; roadmap verification harness). Producer: the deterministic simulator (R5), later fault simulation (R6).

name: kernel.decision_latency
description: Kernel decision latency of one command on one host (11 §13 Runtime). Producers: loka play and the simulator on Node (R5), the local authority on Hermes (R6, R6P phone timing).

name: agent.work
description: One agent's tokens and the outcome of its pull request (ADR-075 §6; the roadmap re-estimates). Producer: the PM, when a pull request merges or closes.
